sources.quote: Destination Canada projects roughly $141 billion in visitor spending for 2026, about 6% above 2025
sources.title: Canada’s global moment sets tourism sector on course for a banner 2026 and growth to 2035 | Destination Canada
sources.evidence: The tourism sector is projected to boost the economy with $140.9 billion in visitor spending in 2026, up 6% from 2025, according to Destination Canada's Canadian Tourism Outlook 2026–2035, prepared with Tourism Economics.

sources.quote: British Columbia's Municipal and Regional District Tax of up to 3%
sources.title: Accommodation - Province of British Columbia
sources.evidence: The MRDT is a tax of up to 3% charged on sales of taxable accommodation and is collected on behalf of municipalities, regional districts and other eligible entities to raise revenue for local tourism, marketing, programs and projects.

sources.quote: British Columbia has required a provincial registration number on short term rental listings since 1 May 2025, and from June 2025 platforms have had to stop advertising listings without a valid number
sources.title: Province moving forward on short-term rental rules
sources.evidence: Hosts will receive a provincial registration number that must be displayed on all online listings in B.C., effective May 1, 2025. As of June 2, 2025, if a short-term rental listing does not have a valid registration number, platforms must stop advertising the listing and prevent new bookings from that host.

sources.quote: The first contested case, against Cineplex, drew a penalty of roughly $38.9 million, upheld on appeal
sources.title: Statement from the Acting Commissioner of Competition on appeal court's ruling in Cineplex deceptive marketing case - Canada.ca
sources.evidence: The Tribunal ordered Cineplex to pay a financial penalty of over $38.9 million dollars and legal costs. On January 21, 2026, the Federal Court of Appeal dismissed Cineplex's appeal, with costs.

sources.quote: implied consent from a stay expires two years after the last booking
sources.title: From Canada’s Anti-Spam Legislation (CASL) Guidance on Implied Consent | CRTC
sources.evidence: An existing business relationship is established if the recipient has made a purchase or lease of goods, services, land or interest in land within the two-year period immediately before the day on which the message was sent; six months in the case of an inquiry.

sources.quote: must register, show the registration number prominently in advertising and quote all-in prices
sources.title: Advertising Requirements
sources.evidence: Registered travel agents or travel wholesalers must display their TICO registration number when communicating information to people about travel services, including advertisements, websites, or brochures. Any representation that refers to a price shall set out the total amount that the customer will be required to pay for the travel services, including all fees, levies, service charges, surcharges, taxes, and other charges.

sources.quote: Then add metasearch and free booking links, which cost nothing to place
sources.title: About hotel free booking links - Hotel Center Help
sources.evidence: Booking partners pay no fee for free booking links, and Google doesn't collect any payment for placement or user engagement with these links. No one can buy better placement for free booking links.
